WITH identities(tool, mode, field, pattern) AS (
  -- tool, mode (cloud | assist | review), field (pr_author | commit_author_name | commit_author_email |
  -- coauthor | review_author), pattern (lower case). Add or remove rows here per company.
  -- Basis of each row: docs/agent_identities.md.
  SELECT 'copilot', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^(copilot|copilot-swe-agent\\[bot\\])$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'copilot', 'review', 'review_author', '^(copilot|copilot-pull-request-reviewer\\[bot\\])$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^cursor\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'commit_author_name', '^cursor agent$'                   -- git name seen in public commits, agent_identities.md table B
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'commit_author_email', '^cursoragent@cursor\\.com$'       -- git e-mail seen in public commits, agent_identities.md table B
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^claude\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'cloud', 'commit_author_name', '^claude$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'assist', 'coauthor', 'claude\\b'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'codex', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^chatgpt-codex-connector\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'codex', 'review', 'review_author', '^chatgpt-codex-connector\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'devin', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^devin-ai-integration\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'devin', 'review', 'review_author', '^devin-ai-integration\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'coderabbit', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^coderabbitai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'coderabbit', 'review', 'review_author', '^coderabbitai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cubic', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^cubic-dev-ai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cubic', 'review', 'review_author', '^cubic-dev-ai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'graphite', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^graphite-app\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'graphite', 'review', 'review_author', '^graphite-app\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'macroscope', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^macroscopeapp\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'macroscope', 'review', 'review_author', '^macroscopeapp\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'qodo', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^qodo-code-review\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'qodo', 'review', 'review_author', '^qodo-code-review\\[bot\\]$'
  -- CUSTOM-TOOLS-INSERT-POINT: tools/build_dashboard.py puts the rows of --custom-tools on the lines after this one (docs/dashboard.md)
),
all_groups AS (
  -- the tool rows of the selected tools only (an excluded tool has no row on the dashboard)
  SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('tool:', tool) AS grp FROM identities WHERE tool IN (${tools:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tool:everything_else'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:cloud_agent'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:ai_assisted'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:review_agent'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:ai_used'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:everything_else'
),
acct AS (
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.user_name,
    -- bot (D11): the is_bot flag, U1's agent bot names, or a login of the identities list
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.is_bot, 0) = 1
           OR a.user_name IN ('Copilot', 'copilot-swe-agent[bot]', 'devin-ai-integration[bot]')
           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i
                       WHERE i.field IN ('pr_author', 'review_author')
                         AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(a.user_name), i.pattern))
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bot
  FROM accounts a
),
pr_base AS (
  -- every PR that was opened or merged in the period; the metrics pick in_created or in_merged (D12)
  SELECT
    pr.id,
    pr.author_id,
    -- the login of the PR author: the account row (accounts.user_name, "cursor[bot]") when there is one; DevLake's
    -- GraphQL path stores pull_requests.author_name without "[bot]" ("cursor"), so that column is used only when the
    -- account row is missing (ADR 0002 A1)
    CASE WHEN au.id IS NULL THEN pr.author_name ELSE au.user_name END AS author_login,
    pr.status,
    pr.created_date,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.head_ref,
    pr.description,
    COALESCE(pr.additions, 0) + COALESCE(pr.deletions, 0) AS size,
    CASE WHEN $__timeFilter(pr.created_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_created,
    CASE WHEN $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_merged
  FROM pull_requests pr
  LEFT JOIN accounts au ON au.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date))
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (${repo_id})
),
valid_comments AS (
  SELECT
    c.pull_request_id,
    c.account_id,
    c.created_date,
    c.type,
    c.status,
    ca.user_name,
    COALESCE(ca.is_bot, 0) AS is_bot
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN acct ca ON ca.id = c.account_id
  WHERE NOT (c.type = 'REVIEW' AND COALESCE(c.status, '') = 'PENDING')                       -- unsent reviews out (as in U1)
),
human_reviews AS (
  -- review rows of people: not a bot, not the PR author (D3)
  SELECT c.pull_request_id AS pr_id, c.created_date, c.status
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE c.type = 'REVIEW'
    AND c.is_bot = 0
    AND c.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)
),
human_reactions AS (
  -- ADR 0002 D16: the rows of people that are U1's first human reaction: a review row, a NORMAL comment or a line comment (DIFF); unsent
  -- reviews are already out of valid_comments; not a bot (D11), not the PR author (D3)
  SELECT c.pull_request_id AS pr_id, c.created_date
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'NORMAL', 'DIFF')
    AND c.is_bot = 0
    AND c.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)
),
first_review AS (
  -- D2: the first submitted review of any state (approved, changes requested, commented, dismissed).
  -- D16: when the dashboard variable first_reaction is 'any', the end of the wait is the first human reaction of any of the three kinds
  SELECT pr_id, MIN(created_date) AS at_time
  FROM (SELECT pr_id, created_date FROM human_reviews WHERE ${first_reaction:sqlstring} <> 'any'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT pr_id, created_date FROM human_reactions WHERE ${first_reaction:sqlstring} = 'any') r
  GROUP BY pr_id
),
final_approval AS (
  -- D9: the last APPROVED review before the merge
  SELECT hr.pr_id, MAX(hr.created_date) AS at_time
  FROM human_reviews hr
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = hr.pr_id
  WHERE hr.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND hr.created_date < p.merged_date
  GROUP BY hr.pr_id
),
tool_commits AS (
  -- ADJUSTMENT POINT (ADR 0002 D15): where the text of a commit of a PR is read from when `commits` has none. The default is the
  -- tool-layer table of DevLake's GitHub plugin (primary key sha only, no connection column; `message` is the text of the commit as GitHub
  -- gave it). That table exists only when the GitHub plugin was built (a DevLake built with DEVLAKE_PLUGINS=gitlab,... does not have it): in
  -- that case replace the line below by an empty list with the same two columns, and the SQL reads `commits` only:
  --   SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(40)) AS sha, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS message FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0
  SELECT t.sha, t.message FROM _tool_github_commits t
),
pr_commit AS (
  -- commits and tool_commits are joined with LEFT JOIN: a PR whose message is in neither stays in every count
  SELECT
    prc.pull_request_id AS pr_id,
    prc.commit_sha,
    prc.commit_author_name,
    prc.commit_author_email,
    prc.commit_authored_date,
    -- the text of the commit (ADR 0002 D15): the domain-layer `commits.message` first, then the tool table. commits.message is a longblob in a
    -- real DevLake (ADR 0002 A2): LOWER() and REGEXP_LIKE() on a binary string are case-sensitive, so the text is converted first. An empty
    -- text counts as no text (NULLIF), so the tool table is read then, too.
    COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(cm.message USING utf8mb4), ''), t.message) AS message,
    -- 1 when the text of this commit came from the tool table (the domain-layer text is missing or empty and the tool table has one)
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(CONVERT(cm.message USING utf8mb4), '') IS NULL AND t.message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS from_tool,
    MIN(prc.commit_authored_date) OVER (PARTITION BY prc.pull_request_id) AS first_commit_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = prc.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN commits cm ON cm.sha = prc.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN tool_commits t ON t.sha = prc.commit_sha
),
marks AS (
  -- m1: the PR author is a cloud agent
  SELECT p.id AS pr_id, i.tool, 'm1' AS mark
  FROM pr_base p
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'cloud' AND i.field = 'pr_author' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(p.author_login), i.pattern)
  UNION
  -- m2: the first commit (D10: all commits with the earliest time) is authored by a cloud agent, by name or e-mail
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm2'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'cloud'
   AND pc.commit_authored_date = pc.first_commit_at
   AND ((i.field = 'commit_author_name' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_name), i.pattern))
     OR (i.field = 'commit_author_email' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_email), i.pattern)))
  UNION
  -- m3: any commit is authored by an AI tool
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm3'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode IN ('cloud', 'assist')
   AND ((i.field = 'commit_author_name' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_name), i.pattern))
     OR (i.field = 'commit_author_email' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_email), i.pattern)))
  UNION
  -- m4: a Co-authored-by line of an AI tool, at the start of a line (real line breaks, or the JSON-string shape)
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm4'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode IN ('cloud', 'assist') AND i.field = 'coauthor'
   AND (REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), CONCAT('^co-authored-by:[ \\t]*(?:', i.pattern, ')'), 'm')
     OR REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), CONCAT('(^"?|\\\\n)co-authored-by:[ \\t]*(?:', i.pattern, ')')))
  UNION
  -- m5: a "Made-with: Cursor" line, at the start of a line
  SELECT pc.pr_id, 'cursor', 'm5'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), '^made-with:[ \\t]*cursor\\b', 'm')
     OR REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), '(^"?|\\\\n)made-with:[ \\t]*cursor\\b')
  UNION
  -- m6: a review row (REVIEW or a line comment of a review, D13) written by a review agent
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, i.tool, 'm6'
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'review' AND i.field = 'review_author' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(c.user_name), i.pattern)
  WHERE c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF')
  UNION
  -- x1 (own marker): head_ref prefix
  SELECT p.id, x.tool, 'x1'
  FROM pr_base p
  JOIN (SELECT 'copilot/' AS prefix, 'copilot' AS tool
        UNION ALL SELECT 'codex/', 'codex'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor/', 'cursor'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'devin/', 'devin'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'claude/', 'claude') x ON p.head_ref LIKE CONCAT(x.prefix, '%')
  WHERE ${include_own_markers:sqlstring} = '1'
  UNION
  -- x2 (own marker): the PR body has Co-Authored-By: Claude
  SELECT p.id, 'claude', 'x2'
  FROM pr_base p
  WHERE ${include_own_markers:sqlstring} = '1' AND LOWER(p.description) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%'
),
marks_sel AS (
  -- the selection of the dashboard (ADR 0002 D17), made on the marks of every kind, also m5, x1 and x2 whose tool is written in this file and
  -- not read from identities: the tool of the mark is included, and the mode that the mark gives is included
  SELECT m.pr_id, m.tool, m.mark
  FROM marks m
  WHERE m.tool IN (${tools:sqlstring})
    AND CASE WHEN m.mark IN ('m1', 'm2') THEN 'cloud'
             WHEN m.mark = 'm6' THEN 'review'
             ELSE 'assist' END IN (${modes:sqlstring})
),
pr_tool AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, tool FROM marks_sel
),
pr_mode AS (
  SELECT pr_id, 'cloud_agent' AS mode FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m1', 'm2')
  UNION
  SELECT pr_id, 'ai_assisted' FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m3', 'm4', 'm5', 'x1', 'x2')
  UNION
  SELECT pr_id, 'review_agent' FROM marks_sel WHERE mark = 'm6'
),
pr_cloud_tool AS (
  -- the tools whose cloud agent opened the PR or made its first commit (m1, m2)
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, tool FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m1', 'm2')
),
pr_group AS (
  SELECT pr_id, CONCAT('tool:', tool) AS grp FROM pr_tool
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, 'tool:everything_else' FROM pr_base p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_tool t WHERE t.pr_id = p.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pr_id, CONCAT('mode:', mode) FROM pr_mode
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, 'mode:ai_used' FROM pr_mode
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, 'mode:everything_else' FROM pr_base p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_mode m WHERE m.pr_id = p.id)
),
first_commit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, first_commit_at FROM pr_commit
),
pr_facts AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.status,
    p.size,
    p.in_created,
    p.in_merged,
    -- time to first review: from the PR being opened (D1) to the first human review
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_date, fr.at_time) AS ttfr_min,
    -- time in review: from the PR being opened (D1) to the final approval, or to the merge (D5); merged PRs only
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL
         THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_date, COALESCE(fa.at_time, p.merged_date)) END AS tir_min,
    -- cycle time: from the first commit or the opening of the PR, whichever is earlier, to the merge; merged PRs only
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL
         THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, LEAST(p.created_date, COALESCE(fc.first_commit_at, p.created_date)), p.merged_date) END AS cycle_min,
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL THEN YEARWEEK(p.merged_date, 3) END AS yw           -- D6: ISO week, Monday first
  FROM pr_base p
  LEFT JOIN first_review fr ON fr.pr_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN final_approval fa ON fa.pr_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN first_commit fc ON fc.pr_id = p.id
),
grp_vals AS (
  SELECT g.grp, 'ttfr' AS m, f.ttfr_min AS v
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_created = 1 AND f.ttfr_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'tir', f.tir_min
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND f.tir_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'cycle', f.cycle_min
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND f.cycle_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'size', f.size
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_created = 1
),
grp_ranked AS (
  SELECT grp, m, v, percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY grp, m ORDER BY v) AS rk
  FROM grp_vals
),
grp_stats AS (
  SELECT grp, m, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(v) AS mean_v, MAX(CASE WHEN rk <= 0.5 THEN v END) AS median_v
  FROM grp_ranked
  GROUP BY grp, m
), metric AS (
-- Merged PRs merged in the period. tool:/mode: rows = the period total of the group.
-- week:<YEARWEEK(merged_date, 3)> rows = the PRs merged in that week, all and per mode.
-- tool:<name>|week:<YEARWEEK> rows = the PRs of that tool merged in that week (only the combinations that have one).
SELECT
  ag.grp,
  COALESCE(s.merged, 0) AS merged,
  NULL AS merged_cloud_agent,
  NULL AS merged_ai_assisted,
  NULL AS merged_review_agent,
  NULL AS merged_ai_used,
  NULL AS merged_everything_else
FROM all_groups ag
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT g.grp, COUNT(*) AS merged
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1
  GROUP BY g.grp
) s ON s.grp = ag.grp
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT('week:', f.yw),
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:cloud_agent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:ai_assisted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:review_agent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:ai_used') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:everything_else') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM pr_facts f
WHERE f.in_merged = 1
GROUP BY f.yw
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT(g.grp, '|week:', f.yw),
  COUNT(*),
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND g.grp LIKE 'tool:%'
GROUP BY g.grp, f.yw
ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM metric
WHERE (${comparison:sqlstring} = 'tools' AND grp LIKE 'tool:%' AND grp NOT LIKE '%|%')
   OR (${comparison:sqlstring} = 'modes' AND grp IN ('mode:cloud_agent', 'mode:ai_assisted', 'mode:review_agent', 'mode:everything_else'))
   OR (${comparison:sqlstring} = 'ai_used' AND grp IN ('mode:ai_used', 'mode:everything_else'))
ORDER BY grp

  FROM grp_ranked

SELECT

FROM all_groups ag

    a.id,
    a.user_name,

    pr.merged_date,

        UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor/', 'cursor'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'devin/', 'devin'

-- week:<YEARWEEK(merged_date, 3)> rows = the PRs merged in that week, all and per mode.
-- tool:<name>|week:<YEARWEEK> rows = the PRs of that tool merged in that week (only the combinations that have one).
SELECT
  ag.grp,
  COALESCE(s.merged, 0) AS merged,
  NULL AS merged_cloud_agent,
  NULL AS merged_ai_assisted,
  NULL AS merged_review_agent,
  NULL AS merged_ai_used,
  NULL AS merged_everything_else

  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1
  GROUP BY g.grp

UNION ALL

  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:cloud_agent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),

  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:review_agent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:ai_used') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_group g WHERE g.pr_id = f.id AND g.grp = 'mode:everything_else') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM pr_facts f
WHERE f.in_merged = 1
GROUP BY f.yw
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT(g.grp, '|week:', f.yw),
  COUNT(*),
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND g.grp LIKE 'tool:%'
GROUP BY g.grp, f.yw
ORDER BY 1

WHERE (${comparison:sqlstring} = 'tools' AND grp LIKE 'tool:%|week:%')
   OR (${comparison:sqlstring} IN ('modes', 'ai_used') AND grp LIKE 'week:%')
ORDER BY grp

),

  UNION ALL

  WHERE f.in_created = 1 AND f.ttfr_min IS NOT NULL

  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id

  WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND f.cycle_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'size', f.size
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_created = 1
),

  FROM grp_vals
),

  FROM grp_ranked

    WHERE g.grp = 'mode:cloud_agent' AND f.in_created = 1) AS prs,

    WHERE g.grp = 'mode:cloud_agent' AND f.in_created = 1 AND f.status = 'CLOSED') AS closed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
    WHERE g.grp = 'mode:cloud_agent' AND f.in_created = 1 AND f.status = 'OPEN') AS open

  CONCAT('mode:cloud_agent|', ag.grp),
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_cloud_tool ct JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = ct.pr_id
    WHERE CONCAT('tool:', ct.tool) = ag.grp AND f.in_created = 1),
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_cloud_tool ct JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = ct.pr_id
    WHERE CONCAT('tool:', ct.tool) = ag.grp AND f.in_merged = 1 AND f.status = 'MERGED'),

WHERE (${comparison:sqlstring} = 'tools' AND grp LIKE 'mode:cloud_agent|tool:%')

           OR a.user_name IN ('Copilot', 'copilot-swe-agent[bot]', 'devin-ai-integration[bot]')

  FROM pull_requests pr

),

  SELECT
    pr.id,
    pr.author_id,
    pr.status,
    pr.created_date,
    pr.additions + pr.deletions AS size,
    CASE
      WHEN pl.login IN ('Copilot', 'copilot-swe-agent[bot]') THEN 'copilot'                -- rule 1
      WHEN pl.login = 'devin-ai-integration[bot]' THEN 'devin'                              -- rule 2

        OR LOWER(pr.description) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%' THEN 'claude'              -- rule 7
      WHEN COALESCE(au.is_bot, 0) = 1 THEN 'other_bot'                                      -- rule 8
      ELSE 'no_marker'                                                                      -- rule 9
    END AS agent
  FROM pull_requests pr
  LEFT JOIN acct au ON au.id = pr.author_id
  LEFT JOIN pr_login pl ON pl.id = pr.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (${repo_id})
),
valid_comments AS (
  SELECT
    c.pull_request_id,
    c.account_id,
    c.created_date,
    c.type,
    c.status,

  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN acct ca ON ca.id = c.account_id
  WHERE NOT (c.type = 'REVIEW' AND COALESCE(c.status, '') = 'PENDING')                      -- safeguard: unsent reviews out
),
pr_facts AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.agent,
    p.status,
    p.size,
    -- metric 2: all three comment types counted (NORMAL, DIFF, REVIEW)
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = p.id) AS n_comments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = p.id AND c.is_bot = 0) AS n_comments_human,

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM valid_comments c

      WHERE c.pull_request_id = p.id
        AND c.is_bot = 0
        AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)) AS first_human_min,
    -- metric 1B: the same, and the commenter is not an assignee of the PR
    (SELECT MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_date, c.created_date)) FROM valid_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = p.id
        AND c.is_bot = 0
        AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_assignees asg
                         WHERE asg.pull_request_id = p.id AND asg.assignee_id = c.account_id)) AS first_human_min_excl_assignee
  FROM pr_base p
), metric AS (
SELECT
  g.agent,
  g.sort_no AS sort_no,
  COALESCE(s.pr_count, 0) AS pr_count,
  m.median_value AS median_comments,
  mh.median_value AS median_comments_excl_bots
FROM agents g
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, COUNT(*) AS pr_count FROM pr_facts GROUP BY agent
) s ON s.agent = g.agent
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, MAX(v) AS median_value FROM (
    SELECT agent, n_comments AS v, percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY agent ORDER BY n_comments) AS rk
    FROM pr_facts
  ) r WHERE rk <= 0.5 GROUP BY agent
) m ON m.agent = g.agent
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agent, MAX(v) AS median_value FROM (
    SELECT agent, n_comments_human AS v, percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY agent ORDER BY n_comments_human) AS rk
    FROM pr_facts
  ) r WHERE rk <= 0.5 GROUP BY agent
) mh ON mh.agent = g.agent
ORDER BY g.sort_no
)
SELECT * FROM metric
ORDER BY sort_no

ORDER BY g.sort_no
)
SELECT * FROM metric
ORDER BY sort_no

targets.rawSql:
WITH identities(tool, mode, field, pattern) AS (
  -- tool, mode (cloud | assist | review), field (pr_author | commit_author_name | commit_author_email |
  -- coauthor | review_author), pattern (lower case). Add or remove rows here per company.
  -- Basis of each row: docs/agent_identities.md.
  SELECT 'copilot', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^(copilot|copilot-swe-agent\\[bot\\])$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'copilot', 'review', 'review_author', '^(copilot|copilot-pull-request-reviewer\\[bot\\])$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^cursor\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'commit_author_name', '^cursor agent$'                   -- git name seen in public commits, agent_identities.md table B
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor', 'cloud', 'commit_author_email', '^cursoragent@cursor\\.com$'       -- git e-mail seen in public commits, agent_identities.md table B
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^claude\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'cloud', 'commit_author_name', '^claude$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'claude', 'assist', 'coauthor', 'claude\\b'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'codex', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^chatgpt-codex-connector\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'codex', 'review', 'review_author', '^chatgpt-codex-connector\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'devin', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^devin-ai-integration\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'devin', 'review', 'review_author', '^devin-ai-integration\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'coderabbit', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^coderabbitai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'coderabbit', 'review', 'review_author', '^coderabbitai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cubic', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^cubic-dev-ai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cubic', 'review', 'review_author', '^cubic-dev-ai\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'graphite', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^graphite-app\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'graphite', 'review', 'review_author', '^graphite-app\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'macroscope', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^macroscopeapp\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'macroscope', 'review', 'review_author', '^macroscopeapp\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'qodo', 'cloud', 'pr_author', '^qodo-code-review\\[bot\\]$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'qodo', 'review', 'review_author', '^qodo-code-review\\[bot\\]$'
  -- CUSTOM-TOOLS-INSERT-POINT: tools/build_dashboard.py puts the rows of --custom-tools on the lines after this one (docs/dashboard.md)
),
all_groups AS (
  -- the tool rows of the selected tools only (an excluded tool has no row on the dashboard)
  SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('tool:', tool) AS grp FROM identities WHERE tool IN (${tools:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tool:everything_else'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:cloud_agent'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:ai_assisted'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:review_agent'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:ai_used'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mode:everything_else'
),
acct AS (
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.user_name,
    -- bot (D11): the is_bot flag, U1's agent bot names, or a login of the identities list
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.is_bot, 0) = 1
           OR a.user_name IN ('Copilot', 'copilot-swe-agent[bot]', 'devin-ai-integration[bot]')
           OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i
                       WHERE i.field IN ('pr_author', 'review_author')
                         AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(a.user_name), i.pattern))
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bot
  FROM accounts a
),
pr_base AS (
  -- every PR that was opened or merged in the period; the metrics pick in_created or in_merged (D12)
  SELECT
    pr.id,
    pr.author_id,
    -- the login of the PR author: the account row (accounts.user_name, "cursor[bot]") when there is one; DevLake's
    -- GraphQL path stores pull_requests.author_name without "[bot]" ("cursor"), so that column is used only when the
    -- account row is missing (ADR 0002 A1)
    CASE WHEN au.id IS NULL THEN pr.author_name ELSE au.user_name END AS author_login,
    pr.status,
    pr.created_date,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.head_ref,
    pr.description,
    COALESCE(pr.additions, 0) + COALESCE(pr.deletions, 0) AS size,
    CASE WHEN $__timeFilter(pr.created_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_created,
    CASE WHEN $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_merged
  FROM pull_requests pr
  LEFT JOIN accounts au ON au.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date))
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (${repo_id})
),
valid_comments AS (
  SELECT
    c.pull_request_id,
    c.account_id,
    c.created_date,
    c.type,
    c.status,
    ca.user_name,
    COALESCE(ca.is_bot, 0) AS is_bot
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN acct ca ON ca.id = c.account_id
  WHERE NOT (c.type = 'REVIEW' AND COALESCE(c.status, '') = 'PENDING')                       -- unsent reviews out (as in U1)
),
human_reviews AS (
  -- review rows of people: not a bot, not the PR author (D3)
  SELECT c.pull_request_id AS pr_id, c.created_date, c.status
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE c.type = 'REVIEW'
    AND c.is_bot = 0
    AND c.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)
),
human_reactions AS (
  -- ADR 0002 D16: the rows of people that are U1's first human reaction: a review row, a NORMAL comment or a line comment (DIFF); unsent
  -- reviews are already out of valid_comments; not a bot (D11), not the PR author (D3)
  SELECT c.pull_request_id AS pr_id, c.created_date
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = c.pull_request_id
  WHERE c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'NORMAL', 'DIFF')
    AND c.is_bot = 0
    AND c.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (p.author_id IS NULL OR p.author_id = '' OR c.account_id <> p.author_id)
),
first_review AS (
  -- D2: the first submitted review of any state (approved, changes requested, commented, dismissed).
  -- D16: when the dashboard variable first_reaction is 'any', the end of the wait is the first human reaction of any of the three kinds
  SELECT pr_id, MIN(created_date) AS at_time
  FROM (SELECT pr_id, created_date FROM human_reviews WHERE ${first_reaction:sqlstring} <> 'any'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT pr_id, created_date FROM human_reactions WHERE ${first_reaction:sqlstring} = 'any') r
  GROUP BY pr_id
),
final_approval AS (
  -- D9: the last APPROVED review before the merge
  SELECT hr.pr_id, MAX(hr.created_date) AS at_time
  FROM human_reviews hr
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = hr.pr_id
  WHERE hr.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.merged_date IS NOT NULL AND hr.created_date < p.merged_date
  GROUP BY hr.pr_id
),
tool_commits AS (
  -- ADJUSTMENT POINT (ADR 0002 D15): where the text of a commit of a PR is read from when `commits` has none. The default is the
  -- tool-layer table of DevLake's GitHub plugin (primary key sha only, no connection column; `message` is the text of the commit as GitHub
  -- gave it). That table exists only when the GitHub plugin was built (a DevLake built with DEVLAKE_PLUGINS=gitlab,... does not have it): in
  -- that case replace the line below by an empty list with the same two columns, and the SQL reads `commits` only:
  --   SELECT CAST(NULL AS CHAR(40)) AS sha, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS message FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0
  SELECT t.sha, t.message FROM _tool_github_commits t
),
pr_commit AS (
  -- commits and tool_commits are joined with LEFT JOIN: a PR whose message is in neither stays in every count
  SELECT
    prc.pull_request_id AS pr_id,
    prc.commit_sha,
    prc.commit_author_name,
    prc.commit_author_email,
    prc.commit_authored_date,
    -- the text of the commit (ADR 0002 D15): the domain-layer `commits.message` first, then the tool table. commits.message is a longblob in a
    -- real DevLake (ADR 0002 A2): LOWER() and REGEXP_LIKE() on a binary string are case-sensitive, so the text is converted first. An empty
    -- text counts as no text (NULLIF), so the tool table is read then, too.
    COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(cm.message USING utf8mb4), ''), t.message) AS message,
    -- 1 when the text of this commit came from the tool table (the domain-layer text is missing or empty and the tool table has one)
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(CONVERT(cm.message USING utf8mb4), '') IS NULL AND t.message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS from_tool,
    MIN(prc.commit_authored_date) OVER (PARTITION BY prc.pull_request_id) AS first_commit_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pr_base p ON p.id = prc.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN commits cm ON cm.sha = prc.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN tool_commits t ON t.sha = prc.commit_sha
),
marks AS (
  -- m1: the PR author is a cloud agent
  SELECT p.id AS pr_id, i.tool, 'm1' AS mark
  FROM pr_base p
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'cloud' AND i.field = 'pr_author' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(p.author_login), i.pattern)
  UNION
  -- m2: the first commit (D10: all commits with the earliest time) is authored by a cloud agent, by name or e-mail
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm2'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'cloud'
   AND pc.commit_authored_date = pc.first_commit_at
   AND ((i.field = 'commit_author_name' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_name), i.pattern))
     OR (i.field = 'commit_author_email' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_email), i.pattern)))
  UNION
  -- m3: any commit is authored by an AI tool
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm3'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode IN ('cloud', 'assist')
   AND ((i.field = 'commit_author_name' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_name), i.pattern))
     OR (i.field = 'commit_author_email' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.commit_author_email), i.pattern)))
  UNION
  -- m4: a Co-authored-by line of an AI tool, at the start of a line (real line breaks, or the JSON-string shape)
  SELECT pc.pr_id, i.tool, 'm4'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode IN ('cloud', 'assist') AND i.field = 'coauthor'
   AND (REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), CONCAT('^co-authored-by:[ \\t]*(?:', i.pattern, ')'), 'm')
     OR REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), CONCAT('(^"?|\\\\n)co-authored-by:[ \\t]*(?:', i.pattern, ')')))
  UNION
  -- m5: a "Made-with: Cursor" line, at the start of a line
  SELECT pc.pr_id, 'cursor', 'm5'
  FROM pr_commit pc
  WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), '^made-with:[ \\t]*cursor\\b', 'm')
     OR REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(pc.message), '(^"?|\\\\n)made-with:[ \\t]*cursor\\b')
  UNION
  -- m6: a review row (REVIEW or a line comment of a review, D13) written by a review agent
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, i.tool, 'm6'
  FROM valid_comments c
  JOIN identities i ON i.mode = 'review' AND i.field = 'review_author' AND REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(c.user_name), i.pattern)
  WHERE c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF')
  UNION
  -- x1 (own marker): head_ref prefix
  SELECT p.id, x.tool, 'x1'
  FROM pr_base p
  JOIN (SELECT 'copilot/' AS prefix, 'copilot' AS tool
        UNION ALL SELECT 'codex/', 'codex'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'cursor/', 'cursor'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'devin/', 'devin'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'claude/', 'claude') x ON p.head_ref LIKE CONCAT(x.prefix, '%')
  WHERE ${include_own_markers:sqlstring} = '1'
  UNION
  -- x2 (own marker): the PR body has Co-Authored-By: Claude
  SELECT p.id, 'claude', 'x2'
  FROM pr_base p
  WHERE ${include_own_markers:sqlstring} = '1' AND LOWER(p.description) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%'
),
marks_sel AS (
  -- the selection of the dashboard (ADR 0002 D17), made on the marks of every kind, also m5, x1 and x2 whose tool is written in this file and
  -- not read from identities: the tool of the mark is included, and the mode that the mark gives is included
  SELECT m.pr_id, m.tool, m.mark
  FROM marks m
  WHERE m.tool IN (${tools:sqlstring})
    AND CASE WHEN m.mark IN ('m1', 'm2') THEN 'cloud'
             WHEN m.mark = 'm6' THEN 'review'
             ELSE 'assist' END IN (${modes:sqlstring})
),
pr_tool AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, tool FROM marks_sel
),
pr_mode AS (
  SELECT pr_id, 'cloud_agent' AS mode FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m1', 'm2')
  UNION
  SELECT pr_id, 'ai_assisted' FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m3', 'm4', 'm5', 'x1', 'x2')
  UNION
  SELECT pr_id, 'review_agent' FROM marks_sel WHERE mark = 'm6'
),
pr_cloud_tool AS (
  -- the tools whose cloud agent opened the PR or made its first commit (m1, m2)
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, tool FROM marks_sel WHERE mark IN ('m1', 'm2')
),
pr_group AS (
  SELECT pr_id, CONCAT('tool:', tool) AS grp FROM pr_tool
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, 'tool:everything_else' FROM pr_base p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_tool t WHERE t.pr_id = p.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pr_id, CONCAT('mode:', mode) FROM pr_mode
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, 'mode:ai_used' FROM pr_mode
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.id, 'mode:everything_else' FROM pr_base p
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_mode m WHERE m.pr_id = p.id)
),
first_commit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr_id, first_commit_at FROM pr_commit
),
pr_facts AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.status,
    p.size,
    p.in_created,
    p.in_merged,
    -- time to first review: from the PR being opened (D1) to the first human review
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_date, fr.at_time) AS ttfr_min,
    -- time in review: from the PR being opened (D1) to the final approval, or to the merge (D5); merged PRs only
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL
         THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.created_date, COALESCE(fa.at_time, p.merged_date)) END AS tir_min,
    -- cycle time: from the first commit or the opening of the PR, whichever is earlier, to the merge; merged PRs only
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL
         THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, LEAST(p.created_date, COALESCE(fc.first_commit_at, p.created_date)), p.merged_date) END AS cycle_min,
    CASE WHEN p.merged_date IS NOT NULL THEN YEARWEEK(p.merged_date, 3) END AS yw           -- D6: ISO week, Monday first
  FROM pr_base p
  LEFT JOIN first_review fr ON fr.pr_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN final_approval fa ON fa.pr_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN first_commit fc ON fc.pr_id = p.id
),
grp_vals AS (
  SELECT g.grp, 'ttfr' AS m, f.ttfr_min AS v
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_created = 1 AND f.ttfr_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'tir', f.tir_min
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND f.tir_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'cycle', f.cycle_min
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_merged = 1 AND f.cycle_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.grp, 'size', f.size
  FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
  WHERE f.in_created = 1
),
grp_ranked AS (
  SELECT grp, m, v, percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY grp, m ORDER BY v) AS rk
  FROM grp_vals
),
grp_stats AS (
  SELECT grp, m, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(v) AS mean_v, MAX(CASE WHEN rk <= 0.5 THEN v END) AS median_v
  FROM grp_ranked
  GROUP BY grp, m
), metric AS (
-- prs_without_commit_message: PRs opened in the period for which no commit message could be read from `commits` nor from the tool table (D15).
-- prs_commit_message_from_tool_table: PRs opened in the period with at least one commit whose message was read from the tool table because
--   `commits` has no (or an empty) text for it (D15).
-- tool_group_total_minus_pr_total: the sum of the tool groups minus the number of PRs (the overlap), PRs opened in the period.
SELECT
  'check:prs_without_commit_message' AS grp,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_base p
    WHERE p.in_created = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_commit pc WHERE pc.pr_id = p.id AND pc.message IS NOT NULL)) AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'check:prs_commit_message_from_tool_table',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_base p
    WHERE p.in_created = 1
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr_commit pc WHERE pc.pr_id = p.id AND pc.from_tool = 1))
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'check:tool_group_total_minus_pr_total',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_group g JOIN pr_facts f ON f.id = g.pr_id
    WHERE g.grp LIKE 'tool:%' AND f.in_created = 1)
  - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr_base p WHERE p.in_created = 1)
)
SELECT * FROM metric
ORDER BY grp

panels.description: データの穴の確かめ: commit の本文が読めなかった PR の数、本文を GitHub の表から読んだ PR の数、ツールの群の重なりの数。

options.content:
**この画面で見られるもの**
DevLake に取り込んだ GitHub の PR を、AI ツール別・使い方別に比べます。指標は 5 つです: PR のマージ数（PRs merged）、サイクルタイム（Cycle time）、最初のレビューまでの時間（Time to first review）、レビューの時間（Time in review）、PR の大きさ（Batch size）。時間は分で、時刻は UTC です。

**上の選択**
- **比べ方（comparison）**: 「AI ツール別」は各ツールとそれ以外、「使い方別」は cloud agent・AI-assisted・review agent とそれ以外、「AI を使ったか」は AI を使った PR とそれ以外を並べます。どの比べ方でも画面の作りは同じです。
- **含めるツール（tools）・含める使い方（modes）**: 比べる対象を選びます。
- **独自の印（include_own_markers）**: 「標準の見分け方だけ」は commit の作者・共作者・Made-with の行・cloud agent の作者・review agent のレビューだけを見ます。「この repo 独自の見分け方も使う」は、この repo 独自の 2 つの印（branch 名の先頭、PR の本文の Co-Authored-By）も足します。
- **最初の反応の数え方（first_reaction）**: 「レビューだけ」は最初の人のレビュー、「コメントも」は最初の人のレビュー・コメント・行コメントで、Time to first review の終わりを決めます。Time in review と Cycle time は変わりません。

**読み方の注意**
- 1 本の PR は、複数のツール・複数の使い方に数えられることがあります。群の合計は PR の数より多くなることがあります。
- 判定は確度の高い物だけです。確度の低い判定は入れていません。
- 含めないツールの PR は、他に含めたツールの印が無ければ「それ以外」に入ります（母数から除きません）。
- 「この repo 独自の指標」の 3 つの表（U1）は、上の選択（比べ方・ツール・使い方・独自の印・最初の反応の数え方）では変わりません。Repo と時間の範囲だけで変わります。
- 人の名前や login はこの画面に出しません。
- 定義と、原文で決まらない所の決め方は ADR 0002（D16・D17 が最初の反応と外したツールの PR）、画面の作りは ADR 0004 に書いてあります。
